title: app-gateway settings
description: Settings for the gateway itself. No app appears here — an app is a file in apps/, described by app.schema.json.

bind.description: Public listen address for the one Caddy the gateway runs. This is the address the tunnel forwards to, so it should rarely change; -Bind overrides it for a single run.

appsDir.description: Directory scanned for app plugins, relative to this file. Every *.json in it is one app. Point it elsewhere for a second registry, or keep two directories and switch with -Config.

site.description: Chrome for the generated landing page. Present so no app-specific text is baked into the builder.

fallbackIcon.description: Card icon for an app that declares none.

paths.description: Named directories, referenced as ${paths.NAME} in an app's root. Relative values resolve against this file's directory. They exist so relocating a checkout is one edit here rather than one per app.

portRanges.description: The port convention (PORTS.md), keyed by the same names as paths: every app whose root lies under paths.NAME must declare its ports inside portRanges.NAME, all of them within one slot of portSlot ports. Checked at launch, after -Port, so an override cannot leave the app's own slot either. An app under no ranged directory is not checked.

portSlot.description: Ports per app slot. Slots are counted from the start of their range, so with 10 an app in 17000-17999 owns 17010-17019, 17020-17029, and so on.
